places.normalized: Boffin's Bower (fictional house, Our Mutual Friend)
places.quote: Bring me round to the Bower,’ said Silas, when the bargain was closed
places.note: Fictional house; its London location is not stated in this passage.

places.quote: ‘Our House’, as he had been wont to call the mansion
places.note: Wegg's ironic name for the Harmon mansion, not a proper name for a map.

places.quote: assuming the mask of careless yielding to a fortuitous combination of circumstances impelling him towards Clerkenwell
the Roman Empire usually declined in the morning
places.note: Historical polity used figuratively for Wegg's reading; not a mappable place in this sense.

places.quote: if a sociable glass of old Jamaikey warm should meet your views
places.note: Refers to Jamaica rum, not a visit to the island; marginal.
